NPA local-government plan catalogue location only. Area-specific plans, dates, duplicates and content must be checked individually; no plan is assumed current or adopted in Kit.

Official 2019 locality population by sex and age, including source-noted estimates for security-affected places. Use the 2019 13-region/45-province/351-commune geography; do not relabel it as the 2025 17-region/47-province system. Recheck raw redistribution terms.

Official statistical-table volume has 581 identified table headings; 17 have selected adopted values, 11 have reviewed decisions without new adoption, and 553 await semantic review. Table II.10 fertility values conflict with the final report's prose and figure (AreaData evidence: burkina-faso-fertility-source-conflict-2026-09-25.md); do not adopt or reconcile them automatically. Inspect numeric columns, denominators and source versions; regional rates are not commune rates.

Volume 3 Annex 4 monetary-poverty values are small-area estimates combining EHCVM 2018 with 2019 census geography, not directly enumerated census poverty. Annexes 5-9 report distinct census measures. Two whole-city commune aggregates and four incomplete rows were withheld; recheck definitions, geography, and redistribution terms.
This is a modelled 2015 outcome using 2019 census covariates, not 2019 contraceptive prevalence. Three ambiguous commune name matches were withheld; review the crosswalk and raw reuse terms.

December 2024 communal development-plan (PCD) guide predates the 2025 territorial code and administrative reform. Check the guide's current applicability and the chosen locality's legal planning authority; no local plan is implied.

December 2024 regional development-plan (PRD) guide predates the 2025 territorial code and administrative reform. Do not equate a 2019 statistical region with a current planning body without legal crosswalk.

Law no. 024-2025/ALT cover and parliamentary adoption were checked. The 114-page posted PDF is scanned; its article-level requirements and present applicability were not text-verified. Verify exact articles and current consolidated status before prescribing a planning index.

National 2024 monitoring report on local development plans, published in 2025. It is a planning-system reference, not evidence that any selected commune's plan or budget was obtained or approved. Check any area-specific document separately.

Official MATM/CONAFIL catalogue lists local-government budget forecasts and transferred-resource execution reports. Inspect each report body and local identifiers; a forecast is not an approved area budget or actual execution.

INSD 2024 national yearbook contains regional and commune fiscal tables and source caveats. Reacquire the full PDF, check numeric columns and null-value notes, and reconcile historical geography before adoption.

Official 2025 procurement notice for preparing Komsilga's PCD. This is a lead to the planning process, not a completed or approved plan, local budget or implementation result. Verify current commune identity.

Government notice describes a 2026 commune-status decree but does not supply a verified 2019-to-current unit crosswalk. Locate the decree and official unit list before joining current authorities to census communes.
New AreaData location: official INSD regional yearbook catalogue lists 2024 and 2023 editions. Individual PDFs, numeric tables, terms and 2025 geography correspondence are not audited or adopted.

New AreaData location: 30 July 2026 official council notice reports competence and resource transfer decrees under law 024-2025/ALT. Signed decree texts, numbers, commencement and selected-area application are not acquired; this is not a plan or budget.

Kit must independently audit its own acquisition, adjusted versus original population definitions, code/boundary matching and resource-specific terms before adoption.

New COSIT official 2024 census table catalogue location. Thirty PDFs were listed; seven acquired by AreaData and two household-service tables locally adapted. Kit must independently audit acquisition, every table field, official geography, terms and adoption.

New official COSIT table. Electricity-source counts can overlap; the regular-responding-household denominator differs from the domestic-water table. Kit must audit its own source rows and geography; AreaData has no independent ACCEPT.

New official COSIT primary water source used at home table. Piped inside dwelling is not a drinking-water or safe-water measure; denominator and categories differ from electricity. Kit must audit independently.

Official Ministry of Finance 2026 national citizen-budget location. AreaData has not audited its table fields. It is not a selected governorate plan, local budget execution or official evaluation.
